limitations: Only primitive least-period-three cycles of the full supporting-line map are addressed, not the boundary-restricted map, periods of other lengths, or global basins. Publication priority in uninspected sources remains uncertain.

title: Exact two-orientation classification of primitive three-cycles for the farthest-projection triangle map
